title: Fix Window Stack Active Chrome
description: When changing the active window to another window stack, the previous active tab and fullscreen button maintain their active marker incorrectly.
summary: Multi-tab Mode dock stack-active tabs now use the same filled primary styling as single-window tabs (`modeDockActiveTabFillClass`: bg-active-base, text-active-foreground) while keeping the U-cap border chrome. Single-tab stacks reuse the shared fill constant. Vitest assertions lock primary fill on globally active stack tabs.
